companion_apps.notes: Not required for passive monitoring. The reviewed Play metadata was 3.8.2 while the separately acquired binary was 3.8.3; they are not treated as identical.

identity.notes: Keep the numeric manufacturer key as protocol metadata, not as a WS03/WS07/WS08 guess.

discovery.none: Manual selection only. Neither the shared fff0 service UUID nor any numeric manufacturer key may select this spec by itself. After the owner selects a candidate, require fff0, an accepted numeric key and a reconstructed 20- or 22-byte record together before treating it as this family; only the 20-byte form may emit measurements.

identification.notes: No automatic matcher is declared: fff0 is shared by unrelated products and the numeric manufacturer keys are not unique company identity. The vendor app also uses the local name ThermoBeacon on its connected scan path, but that name alone is not a passive matcher here. Use the manual compound verification in protocol_details.advertisement_verification.

device.manufacturer: SensorBlue / SEVEN-LIKE (OEM relationship not fully established)
device.name: SensorBlue ThermoBeacon Hygrometers
device.notes:
The passive parser requires advertised service UUID 0000fff0-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb and one of seven numeric manufacturer keys: 0x10, 0x11, 0x14, 0x15, 0x18, 0x1b or 0x30. These are numeric protocol identifiers, NOT a proven one-to-one mapping to WS03/WS07/WS08 and not a claim about the vendor's Bluetooth SIG company assignments.
For decoding, prepend the scanner's two-byte little-endian numeric key to the manufacturer payload. Only the resulting 20-byte form emits measurements. The 22-byte form corroborates the family during manual compound verification but is otherwise undocumented here; all other lengths are rejected.
The similarly spelled connected service and its history/settings protocol are deliberately absent. The passive 0000fff0 advertisement filter is not evidence that this spec can download history or change settings. Integration is identify_only until a real handler implements manual selection, compound verification and measurement decoding.

pairing.notes: No pairing, bonding or app-layer credential is needed for the passive measurement stream.

credentials.notes: Measurements are unencrypted broadcasts. No history/settings or cloud credentials are included.

factory_reset.description: No verified manual or capture establishing reset was found; do not experiment with connected writes.
factory_reset.effect: No reset procedure is established. Passive monitoring holds no bond, network membership or client credential on the sensor; settings/history reset behavior is outside this spec.

methods.description: After manual selection, passively verify fff0 plus a known numeric key and a 20/22-byte reconstructed record; decode only the 20-byte form.

steps.action: Power the sensor and select the SensorBlue/ThermoBeacon candidate manually; do not select it from fff0 or a numeric key alone.
Require the fff0 service UUID, one of the seven numeric manufacturer keys and a reconstructed record of exactly 20 or 22 bytes together.
Prepend the key in little-endian and accept a measurement only when the reconstructed record is exactly 20 bytes.
steps.expect: Temperature, humidity, battery millivolts and the raw button bit update; fff0-only, numeric-key-only, 22-byte and malformed records emit no measurement.

setup.notes: Nothing is provisioned or paired for the broadcast stream. Public parser fixtures support the decode; this project did not scan hardware.

rejoin.notes: There is no host or network binding to move.

steps.action: Start the same passive filter on the replacement controller.
steps.expect: The next valid 20-byte advertisement produces a reading without access to the old controller.

testing.notes: No hardware, advertisement capture, history download or settings write was performed. The 20-byte decoder is transcribed from the maintained public parser and checked against its sanitized fixtures; physical accuracy and retail-model mapping are not established.

entities.name: Temperature
entities.notes: Signed int16 little-endian / 16 from reconstructed bytes 12-13.

entities.name: Humidity
entities.notes: Unsigned int16 little-endian / 16 from reconstructed bytes 14-15.

entities.name: Battery Voltage
entities.notes: Direct unsigned value from bytes 10-11; preferred over the estimate.

entities.name: Estimated Battery
entities.notes: Derived piecewise estimate only; never describe it as a transmitted percentage.

entities.name: Button Event
entities.notes: Raw high bit of byte 3 using the public library's occupancy-style mapping; physical occupancy semantics are unverified.

artifacts.description: Passive fff0/numeric-key filter, 20-byte measurement layout, 22-byte identification boundary and battery estimate.
Corroborated the Sensor Blue/ThermoBeacon ecosystem and the separate connected surface; no history/settings behavior claimed.

evidence.documentation_review: Reviewed Bluetooth-Devices/thermobeacon-ble at 0379cb71c2df8dc8764267e96dbaf4e58d8d4d67 and its sanitized parser fixtures on 2026-11-10. Its 14 tests passed. Static vendor-app review established only the ecosystem/linkage; no connected command bytes are reproduced here.
evidence.open_questions: Retail SKU mapping, 22-byte semantics, physical button meaning, battery-estimate boundaries and all connected history/settings behavior remain unresolved.

ThermoBeacon20.description: Twenty-byte record formed as numeric_key_u16le || manufacturer_payload. Multi-byte measurement fields are little-endian. Offsets are relative to the reconstructed record, including the two key bytes.

fields.description: Low byte of the numeric key; one of 0x10/11/14/15/18/1b/30, with no WS retail mapping
fields.name: device_type

fields.description: High byte of the numeric key; zero in all accepted public fixtures
fields.name: device_type_high

fields.description: High bit at byte 3; the library exposes it as an occupancy-style event, not proof of room occupancy
fields.name: button_pressed

fields.description: Signed 1/16 C at bytes 12-13; reject the whole record above 100 C
fields.name: temperature

fields.description: Unsigned 1/16 percent at bytes 14-15; reject the whole record above 100 percent
fields.name: humidity

parse_rules: Require exactly 20 bytes for measurement output. A 22-byte record is identification-only; all other lengths are ignored.
temperature = int16le(bytes 12-13) / 16 C; humidity = uint16le(bytes 14-15) / 16 percent; battery_mv = uint16le(bytes 10-11).
If decoded temperature > 100 C or humidity > 100 percent, discard the entire measurement rather than publishing partial fields.
Battery percentage is NOT transmitted. If an estimate is wanted, apply only protocol_details.battery_estimate and label it estimated.

rules: After manual candidate selection, ALL of fff0, an accepted numeric key and an accepted reconstructed length are required; no subset selects this spec.
A 22-byte reconstructed record corroborates identity only. Require exactly 20 bytes before decoding or emitting measurements.
fff0-only, numeric-key-only and all other reconstructed lengths fail closed.

battery_estimate.notes: Piecewise library estimate, not a measured state of charge. Preserve battery_mv as the authoritative value and label any derived percentage as estimated.

excluded_surfaces: The 22-byte record's additional semantics; it is identification-only here
Connected history, settings, calibration and all GATT writes
Any assignment of a numeric ID to WS03, WS07 or WS08 without new evidence

remaining_unknowns: One-to-one mapping from numeric IDs 0x10/11/14/15/18/1b/30 to WS03/WS07/WS08 is unproven.
The 22-byte advertisement corroborates a manually selected candidate, but its extra bytes and measurement semantics are not established.
Button-event semantics and the battery-percentage estimate need comparison with on-device indicators.
Connected history/settings framing is excluded pending fresh read-only model-specific captures.
No standalone official WS03/WS07/WS08 manual was verified.
